steps.caption: New leases always start as draft or negotiation. Executed and active need evidence: a signed agreement and confirmed dates.
Choose the tenant company. If it is not a company record yet, type its name in the box below instead.
Choose the landlord and the property. Unknown is allowed — nothing is guessed.
Category and status: a conventional office lease, under negotiation.
Monthly rent and area, if you know them. Leave a field blank when unknown — it is never treated as zero.
More details (optional): reference, micro-market, floor, unit, dates, area basis, CAM, parking, deposit, term, lock-in and escalation.
The lease page opens with status Under negotiation. No dates yet — they come from the agreement.
Documents: give the agreement a title and choose its type and execution state.
Paste the text (PDFs and scans go through Capture first). A draft is never treated as executed.
Attach & extract. Code reads the clauses — no AI is needed for dates.
Important dates now lists commencement, expiry and lock-in, each with the source clause and page.
Because the document is a draft, every date is marked Needs review — a person must check it before it counts.
